```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#tidyverse packages
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)

#spatial data
library(sf)

#datavis
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gridExtra)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r read in data and set up fonts, message=FALSE}
#read in lit review data
data <- read.csv(here("data.csv"), na.strings = c("", "NA")) %>% #read in data with empty cells as NA
  clean_names() %>%
  select(-magnitude) %>% 
  select(-mechanism) %>% 
  mutate(habitat_type = ifelse(habitat_type == "subtropical", "tropical", habitat_type))
  #na.omit() #omit NAs

data_unique <- data %>% 
  select(citation, topic, habitat_type, habitat_subtype, geographic_region) %>% #select variable that are constant within each case study
  distinct(citation, habitat_type, geographic_region, .keep_all = TRUE)

#read in MEOW TNC Shapefile
meow <- read_sf(here("MEOW-TNC", "meow_ecos.shp")) %>% 
  clean_names()

#add google fonts to working memory for figures
#font_add_google(name = "Work Sans",   # Name of the font on the Google Fonts site
#                family = "worksans")

#standard theme for all graphs
my_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(base_size = 14)
        #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#source for standard color palettes: https://www.simplifiedsciencepublishing.com/resources/best-color-palettes-for-scientific-figures-and-data-visualizations
#for mpa effect, use six color combination from "Divergent"
mpa_colors <- c("positive_ecosystem" = "#2066a8", 
                "positive_population" = "#cde1ec", 
                "no_effect" = "grey60", 
                "negative_population" = "#f6d6c2", 
                "negative_ecosystem" = "#ae282c")

#for climate effect, use six color combination from "qualitative"
climate_colors <- c("body_size" = "#cecece", 
                    "disease_parasite" = "#a559aa", 
                    "habitat_formation" = "#59a89c", 
                    "mortality" = "#f0c571", 
                    "movement_range" = "#e02b35", 
                    "phenology" = "#082a54", 
                    "reproduction" = "darkolivegreen")

```
